title: Enhancement: [Nexthop] Add watchdog support
author: louis-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

Add watchdog support to NH-4010 and NH-4020.

### Current Behavior

Currently, watchdog is not supported.

### Proposed Behavior

Watchdog to be supported in Nexthop's devices.

#### Why I did it

Add watchdog support for NH-4010 and NH-4020.

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/24224

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

1. Add watchdog's info to `pddf-device.json.j2`.
2. Implement the watchdog support in `platform/broadcom/sonic-platform-modules-nexthop/common/sonic_platform/...`
